classification_scope: Existing default complete exports, main-only and checkpoint-inclusive. No matched-work subbenchmark was established in this bounded review.

rust_source.source_note: Coordinator HEAD advanced during review; all three reviewed runtime files still exactly match this pinned source. Fingerprints are read from immutable git objects.

dotnet.verification: Successfully executed --version, --list-sdks and --list-runtimes; no compilation or replay execution.

contract_differences.rust: Native Events exported; optional checkpoint tables and opt-in independent Reader snapshot callbacks.
contract_differences.reference: ReplayChunkDispatcher reads then skips Checkpoint and Event chunks.
contract_differences.effect: Checkpoint-inclusive work differs; main-only work still differs in native Event handling.

contract_differences.rust: Typed/raw Parquet tables plus manifest; gameplay projections and analysis are separate optional products.
contract_differences.reference: CLI writes events.ndjson and movement.ndjson plus manifest and wraps its sink in ValorantEventEnricher.
contract_differences.effect: Different encoding, rows and enriched semantics; default elapsed export ratios measure different products.

contract_differences.rust: Available raw field windows accompany typed overlay and explicit preservation/loss accounting; not whole-original reconstruction.
contract_differences.reference: Export groups with WasDecoded false or Payload null are filtered; manifest states undecoded groups and empty decoded shells are omitted.
contract_differences.effect: Selected reference RPC raw fallbacks do not establish the same preservation contract.

contract_differences.rust: Emits every decoded movement sample and optional transport provenance.
contract_differences.reference: ComponentDataStream retains LatestMove/MoveCount; enricher emits one latest move per update with index MoveCount - 1.
contract_differences.effect: Latest-move value agreement covers a subset, not all emitted records or equal export work.

contract_differences.rust: File-backed validate/export and read_path use bounded chunks; read_bounded explicitly buffers finite encoded input.
contract_differences.reference: ByteArchiveReader(Stream) copies remaining input to MemoryStream, then ToArray.
contract_differences.effect: Source difference does not itself prove any process RSS advantage.

documentation_corrections.replacement_rust_cell: Native Event chunks are exposed and exported; checkpoint tables require `export --checkpoints`. Reader methods skip snapshots by default; `ReadOptions` enables independent checkpoint callbacks.

Optional helpers expose validated native round/death/spike declarations and phase observations. Opt-in `MainIdentityTimeline` associates main-stream actor/character identities and movement provenance with explicit null, unresolved and ambiguous states. Separate Python tools provide richer joins; this does not establish account identity, kill credit or complete round outcomes.
